title: Eclipse Ransomware Group: Victims, Leak Site, TTPs & IOCs
description: Nightmare Eclipse, also known as Chaotic Eclipse and Dead Eclipse, is a rogue threat actor that emerged in April 2026, operating from Russian-geolocated infrastructure. This individual conducts high-impact zero-day disclosure campaigns against Microsoft products driven by personal vengeance rather than financial motivation. The actor utilizes zero-day exploits targeting Windows security subsystems, including CVE-2026-50656 for privilege escalation, and weaponizes Microsoft Defender Antivirus to gain administrative control over enterprise networks. Primary targets include public administration, healthcare, and finance sectors, with a focus on Windows enterprise endpoints. Initial access is achieved through exploitation of VPN gateways, followed by defense impairment and data encryption activities.
